summary.en: The most frequent neighbouring pairs, counted one a beat: each row’s weight flies from its label to the pair’s bar and lands as a visible segment.
summary.zh: 一拍数一个最常见的相邻字符对：每一行的权重从行标签飞向这对的条，落成看得见的一段。

fits: Counting that is weighted: the weighting is drawn, not said; the top bar is the next step of the run.
notFor: Unweighted counts (a plain bar grows); more than four items to count in a scene.

intent.en: Counting that is weighted is drawn: each row's weight flies to its bar, so the viewer sees why the top pair wins.
intent.zh: 加权计数被画出来：每行的权重飞进自己的条，观众看到为什么最上面那对赢。

content.en: The run (as chip-split), a caption with [[kind|marked]] words (≤ 64 / 24 字 with markup), the number of pairs shown (≤ 4).
content.zh: 运行输入（同 chip-split），说明里可用 [[kind|词]] 标色（含标记 ≤ 64 字符 / 24 字），显示的字符对数（≤ 4）。

fits.zh: 加权的计数：权重被画出来，不是说出来；最长的条就是运行的下一步。

notFor.zh: 不加权的计数（直接长条即可）；一屏超过四项要数。

en: Show at most four pairs a scene; the fifth bar is never read.
zh: 一屏最多四对；第五条没人读。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
